assume_bundles.align: pointer alignment and optional offset promise
assume_bundles.ignore: operand retained only for debugging, no new semantic promise

calling_conventions.constraints: exact lowered signatures; varargs only original C source convention before arena lowering; musttail journal/lifetime compatibility checked
calling_conventions.optional: GHC/HiPE/AnyReg/Swift/target native CC require explicit admitted extension/foreign descriptor

coroutines.generic_ir: Require selected policy metadata or independently verified allocation/alignment equivalence; E-CORO-ALLOCATION-POLICY otherwise.
coroutines.journal_order: CoroSplit before logical journal instrumentation; no activation-owned opaque state in ordinary frame.
coroutines.language_deviation: Pinned P2014 Option2 selection; upstream C++23 default is false.
coroutines.source_allocation: Preserve selected custom/global overload and matching delete/failure path; validate actual nonnull frame alignment before frame access.

cost_model: virtual operations, no native instruction/CPU features; baseline conservative vectorization/FP contraction, all lowerings verified after LLVM optimizations
derived_macros: All other standard language/compiler/FP limit macros generated by pinned Clang from this fixed TargetInfo; no host defaults.

driver.compile: -c emits verified relocatable semantic module; -S emits canonical inspectable SMIR text, not ISA assembly
driver.failure: no output publication until verification; missing runtime/helper implementation is link/admission error, not missing lowering contract
driver.link: resolve declarations and atomic SCC deployment; constructors only after whole required module verification
driver.lto: full/ThinLTO final backend uses identical contract/profile/verifier; no host object fallback
driver.sysroot: --sysroot must contain target/site manifest with exact ABI/site digests

execution_fenv.meaning: immutable copyable snapshot, not owner-thread authority

fenv.default_pointer: normal readonly typed guest object + relocation, no sentinel or host pointer
fenv.errno: API-specific zero/nonzero status; no universal errno mutation
fenv.vm_diagnostics: separate private IEEE-five mask, never captured/changed by C environment APIs; DENORM never diagnostic

flags.Dwarf Version: debug encoding only, never logical EH authority
flags.EnableSplitLTOUnit: LTO planning metadata; both partitions use same final verifier
flags.MaxTLSAlign: validate against accepted TLS allocation geometry
flags.PIC Level: logical relocation policy, no native PIC sequence
flags.PIE Level: logical image binding policy, no host ASLR premise
flags.SDK Version: forbidden host SDK binding in portable compiler output
flags.ThinLTO: LTO planning metadata; no semantic verification bypass
flags.branch-target-enforcement: optional native hardening profile, diagnose unless0
flags.cf-protection-branch: optional native hardening profile, diagnose unless0
flags.cf-protection-return: optional native hardening profile, diagnose unless0
flags.frame-pointer: optional debug logical-frame retention; no physical register
flags.sign-return-address: optional native pointer-auth profile, diagnose unless0

function_addresses.binding_carrier: target("smir.code_binding") is parameterless unsized SSA-only B for the actual checked CodePtr<Fn>; no public source ABI/storage/freeze/foreign escape.
function_addresses.call: Evaluate arguments, observing code_bind with actual plan B, then existing argument noundef/token checks and source-entry A->C/B->C; no guessed callable or native PC.
function_addresses.call_site: call/invoke/tailcall carry mandatory syntax source_plan:opt:entity_ref; Some is original caller C, None legacy generic; never infer C from bind B/Fn/permit.
function_addresses.cpp_caller: Ordinary code_bind/source_plan restrictions remain unchanged; hidden-this/VTT CPP callers require their separately accepted binder/projection. Numeric AS allocation does not close that interface.
function_addresses.domain_selection: AS1 alone does not choose CodeAddress, CodePtr, block-label or native domain. Validate actual original source/descriptor/type context; BlockAddress retains E-CONSTANT-BLOCK-ADDRESS even though LLVM gives it program AS1.
function_addresses.legacy: Existing generic CodePtr<Fn> paths keep their exact type/semantics. New bound generic entry is unavailable until its separate actual interface exists.
function_addresses.llvm_carrier: Allocated logical program AS1: ptr addrspace(1), stable external state, pe1:64:64:64:64-P1. AS0 data includes addresses of function-pointer storage. This contract does not implement TargetInfo/backend.
function_addresses.plan: Every issued ordinary CallSignature has mandatory explicit execution Fn. Function.execution is optional; never a call-site default.
function_addresses.scope_carrier: target("smir.source_scope") is parameterless unsized SSA-only S for actual original source lineage; erase to verified ScopeSlot, never serialize as pointer/int/guest authority.
function_addresses.source_type: Preserve actual function prototype/expression graph even when by-value result or parameter is incomplete; address storage never instantiates a callable Fn.

metadata.alias.scope/noalias: activation-scoped proof metadata until final LLVM pipeline; no reuse after drop
metadata.callees: validate target set then optimization-only promise
metadata.dbg: optional source map; excluded from semantic content hash
metadata.llvm.module.flags: apply pinned merge behavior, then validate every semantic flag via registry
metadata.range/nonnull/align/dereferenceable/noun: preserve deferred-poison or UB promise/refinement exactly; no eager trap for unused results
metadata.tbaa: optimization promise until final LLVM pipeline; may drop with no downstream reuse
metadata.type: admitted normalized type-set and guest-vtable offsets for checked dispatch

operand_bundles.cfguardtarget: Checked code token/signature target validation; no host CFG machinery.
operand_bundles.convergencectrl: Retain token-defined dynamic convergence constraints; optional nonbaseline convergence extension.
operand_bundles.deopt: Optional deoptimization profile; explicit E-EXT-DEOPT, never discard semantic state.
operand_bundles.funclet: Only native EH extension IR. Portable frontend emits Itanium landingpad/invoke logical regions; foreign native EH uses descriptor.
operand_bundles.kcfi: Validate expected admitted code signature/type-set identifier before call; trap mismatch before target entry.
operand_bundles.preallocated: One live stack setup ticket; matches every preallocated param; absent on musttail; teardown or unwind consumes once.
operand_bundles.ptrauth: Optional native pointer authentication; explicit E-EXT-PTRAUTH.

private_eh.exception_ptr: 8B/align8 data_ptr to registered 32B/align8 PROCESS OWNER PROXY
private_eh.slots: compiler-only constant IDs, eliminate FIRST before optimization/LTO/O0 emission
private_eh.typeid_for: remain symbolic through optimization/inlining/LTO, assign FINAL function positive selectors; cleanup0

record_layout.bit_width: full evaluated APInt; pinned frontend rejects >UINT_MAX before ASTRecordLayout as E-SMIR-UPSTREAM-BITFIELD-WIDTH
record_layout.empty_identity: canonical unqualified source class declaration; top CV preserved in complete source hash
record_layout.input: nominal_type.record_input: opt:record_layout_input; Some for complete records, None for nonrecords/incomplete declarations
record_layout.order: actual field/base declaration order; original module-qualified owners retained across selection
record_layout.trait_source: actual pinned CXXRecordDecl APIs, never inferred from size/offsets/LLVM IR
upstream_gaps: ASTRecordLayout rejects struct extent >=2^60 bytes; format/source allocation ceiling remains2^61-1 bytes

vtable_components.component_order: vcall|vbase tokens in increasing physical address order; consumes each separate value vector exactly once
vtable_components.hash: component_order included in V2 selected layout label; no oldorder synthesis

record_layout.witness: tools/smir-llvm-contract/record_layout; native existing-target AST-only subset, not portable certification

source_language_linkage.compatibility: explicit C-boundary view only when both functions c_linkage; complete by-value layouts both sides; opaque pointer pointee may use declaration identity
source_language_linkage.cpp_identity: ordinary overload/RTTI/class/wchar/charN identities remain strict outside C-boundary view
source_language_linkage.function: c_linkage for C23 / C++ extern C; function type entity=function, symbol/export keeps actual link name
source_language_linkage.record_enum: c_compatible only eligible C-header mirror with exact source cohort/tag/layout/trivial/no-C++-only properties
source_language_linkage.upstream_gap: pinned Clang reports C/C++ language-linkage function types equal; declaration linkage metadata must not be inferred from this equality

storage.atomic: ABI selected size/align/mask; generic helpers any positive byte width; truthful non-lock-free
storage.atomic_flag: dedicated1B/align1 nominal type and three lock-free helpers; globals/stack/subobjects/arrays registered before publication; source header keeps flag query identity distinct from ordinary sizeof1 atomicbool
storage.bitint: SSA iN, storage ceil(N/8) rounded to min(8,pow2ceil(bytes)); explicit padded LLVM representation/align; signed writes zero unused padding bits, sign is bitN-1
storage.bool: SSA i1, object i8 values0/1; invalid observed representation follows source/LLVM load metadata semantics
storage.layouts: section1 execution layout size/alignment/access in bytes, stride/field extents in bits; ABI-visible aliases require section10 nominal+storage_binding; temporary representation conversion is explicit code
storage.raw: bN per-bit shadow, never ordinary integer copy that destroys origin labels
storage.variadic: fixed lowered args then exact arena:data_ptr and bytes:u64 both noundef; va_start(list,arena,bytes),copy(dst,src),end(list),arg<T>(list); caller table registration+callee activation cookie

unknown_semantic_metadata: compile diagnostic with key/record/location, never drop
